description: Create or change an API secret: an external API the app reaches with neblla.api.call(name, path, body) without a server of yours. Neblla fills the secret in where {secret} appears in `headers` or `query`, and calls only under `baseUrl` (https, a public host). The value is written and never read back (neblla_list_api_secrets shows everything else); on a change, leave `value` out to keep it. From the server file (room.js…) it always works; from a user's client only with fromClient: true. Limits: loggedInOnly, calls per user per minute / hour / sixHours / day / week / month, and a whole-app cap per day / month (0 or absent = none). The bytes both ways count as quota.

baseUrl.description: The only place it may call, e.g. https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/demo

fromClient.description: Let users' clients call it (default false: only the server file)

headers.description: Headers sent on every call, e.g. { "Authorization": "Bearer {secret}" }

name.description: Secret name: a letter, then letters, digits or _ (≤ 40), e.g. CLOUDINARY

query.description: Query parameters sent on every call, e.g. { "key": "{secret}" }

value.description: The secret itself (≤ 8 KB). Required on create; leave out on a change to keep it

name: neblla_set_api_secret
title: Set api secret
